'''vader12 undefeated profit 1.2''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[vader12]]
* '''Published:''' 19 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif|label=You Can Either Profit By This...}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Profit vader12 LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Rycar Ryjerd (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Seeking An Audience (V), Han (V), Chewbacca (V), Princess Leia (V), Bright Hope (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

profit with heavy beatdowns and massive drains, can take on any darkside deck and come out on top. would appreciate comments from ICEBREATH and CAM. CAN DRAW BATTLE DESTINY OF 87 OR HIGHER, NO JOKE, now with a space package

== Notes ==

* Posted 'Jabbas palace: throne room' dested Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (no Jabba's Palace 'throne room' site exists; the Audience Chamber is Jabba's throne room).
* Posted Tatooine Qui-gon dested Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); Qui-gons saber dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Reflections III), though Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber would match the Tatooine Qui-Gon; Chewies bowcaster dested Chewbacca's Bowcaster.
* The Effects header says 3 but lists 4; the list totals 60. Master Luke x2 is a unique character; dested as posted.
* Original-era (V) cards: Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1); Rycar Ryjerd (V) (Virtual Set 2); Han (V), Chewbacca (V) (Virtual Set 3); Seeking An Audience (V), Princess Leia (V), Bright Hope (V) (Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

STRATEGY

First turn before activation use Rycar(v) to pull any 2 of your character effects. Activate and pull threepio with parts showing and drop him for free to a tatooine site, use his effect then draw a couple of force. Don’t forget to use threepio’s effect during your opponents turn, the idea is to get your sites and control/tunnel visions this way. Second turn activate drop a master luke if you have him and then go pull chewie with seeking an audience, drop chewie and either use chewie to pull rug hug or your last character effect( all of the effects have chewie in their game text, so do a number of the destiny adders, han with heavy blaster and chewies bowcaster so use chewie to the fullest extent. If the dark side started with the 2 aliens at the chamber then go ahead and battle, bounce an alien with luke kill one with chewies bowcaster and possibly knock one out with a sorry about the mess combo and then use your rug hug destiny adder to draw three destiny forfeit chewie and on your next turn free han. Don’t worry, I put 2 chewies in there for a reason, if you don’t get the first one back it’s not the end of the world. Third turn, by now you should have been able to recycle some 7’s with threepio and start to track them as well as pulled at least 1 site or a tunnel vision to get a site. What you want to start doing now is getting leia, chewie, luke, and han all at the same site with weapons and drop the three character effects on them. For those of you who do not know the destructive power of these effects allow me to enlighten you. That’s one goes on chewie and makes his weapon draws +1 and life debt is a used interrupt. Count me in allows leia to use her ability number as a weapon or battle destiny draw once per battle and protecter is a used interrupt. What that means is that you can automatically knock off the table any annoying ability 4 or lower character off the table in a battle. I’m with you too goes on luke and is the best of the bunch, it gives luke, leia, chewie, and han immunity to attrition when they are all in a battle together and their total battle destiny is doubled. Since chewie pulls the battle destiny adders you can reaaly hurt someone with major overflow battle damage. Nabrun hops your characters around to beat down, ben Kenobi brings back a character, qui-gon is used for the jedi presence and to drain with( I normally pull him or ben with the city outskirts), both landos add destiny and the don’t forget about the droids is used to cancel an opponents destiny once you no longer need threepio. This deck can drain as well. Get the jedi out with sabers on them and stick one of your characters that gets you direct damage from your objective at each site, you can take out draw their fire for a wrist comlink and pull that with Rycar(v) to react your characters around on tatooine, if you get into situations where you need that then only try to hold 3 sites with the comlink in the middle. I personally like to use draw their fire so that I can keep them from playing ghhhhhk so that you can deck them out with 1 battle. This deck has taken out a direct damage SYCFA without one battle and a darkside senate where the only battle was in the senate and my power was 0 but I drew a battle destiny of 87. let me know if there is any improvements I can make on this deck, it’s record is 18-0-0 in tournaments so I think the fact about whether or not this works is taken care of. now with a space package, you can stick all four of the gang on the falcon and use the same beatdown in space as you did on the ground, Bright hope and spiral cancels a destiny and use liberty for the forfeit. if a space deck is being played against you then you can start insurrection over rycar because chewie pulls all the effects anyway
